verdict.rationale: Letta documents its own TypeScript Agent SDK, an OpenAI-compatible App Server API, and an ACP adapter. Nothing in the evidence shows a first-party integration that plugs Letta's memory into LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or the Vercel AI SDK. The OpenAI-compatible API and ACP adapter are general interfaces for client apps such as Open WebUI and Zed, not documented framework integrations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drop the memory layer into agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or the Vercel AI SDK via documented first-party integrations
